note: pattyteaa testing a new video format around an open-source handwriting font by @rafcespedes: 'If This Finds You' — real letters by ordinary people, 1395–1929, written out live on screen, every hand a free downloadable font (.otf/.ttf, OFL; repo rafaelcespedes/if-this-finds-you, MIT). The frame shows a 'Dear diary' letter being written with a gesture that mimics how we actually write. She saved it for the handwritten-font look. Honest limit: the reel gates the link behind commenting FONT, so the repo came from a web search, not the post; the site holds 123 letters, each in its original language with source attribution.
title: If This Finds You — real historical hands as free fonts (rafcespedes)
